A.J. Brown (ankle) is expected to be activated from IR on Saturday and play on Sunday against the Jets.
news.analysis: After a four game stint on IR with an ankle sprain, it looks like Brown will return. The Patriots receiver room has been a revolving door of production, with Romeo Doubs, Kyle Williams, and Efton Chism all seeing some sort of success with AJB out. Browns return will likely put Williams and Chism back in limited roles, but Doubs should still she the field fairly consistently.
